title:
Reader for a log written by the C3 {@link Logger}. This should have constructors from various log
storage systems (e.g. local file, splunk, ELK stack). In addition to basic methods for streaming through the
{@link Log.Entry}, this profiler type should be a centralized place to implement various filtering and aggregation
operations.
Example usage
```
log = Log.Profile.fromFile("path/to/my/file.log")
log.entries().each(...)
```
name: Log.Profile
